rationale: The incident is a grease fire originating from the policyholder's own stove, causing structural damage (charred cabinets, smoke-damaged ceiling and walls) to the insured home, with no theft or third-party liability involved.
claim_summary: Policyholder Alex Doe (POL-1001) experienced a contained kitchen grease fire yesterday evening. A flare-up while sauteing on the stove caused charring to the cabinets above the stove and smoke damage to the kitchen ceiling and walls; the rest of the home is unaffected and no injuries were reported. Claim is classified as property_damage at medium severity; no repair estimate has been provided yet and should be obtained by the adjuster.

case_facts.description: Grease fire on stove during cooking; extinguished with fire extinguisher. Charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls.
case_facts.cause: Grease flare-up while sauteing onions on stove
case_facts.damage_area: Kitchen only — cabinets, ceiling, walls; rest of house unaffected

rationale: Flooding originated from the policyholder's own plumbing, causing structural damage (hardwood floors, drywall) and contents damage in the policyholder's own home — a clear property damage claim.
claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) returned from a work trip to find their entire basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water from a failure in their own plumbing. Damage includes buckled hardwood floors spanning the full basement, soaked drywall up to 1 foot high, and ruined stored contents. Severity assessed as HIGH — likely exceeds $25,000 and requires on-site inspection, professional water extraction, mold remediation, flooring replacement, and drywall repair. Policy is active with a $500 deductible and $750,000 coverage limit.

case_facts.description: Returned home from work trip to find basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water across entire basement
case_facts.damage_details: Buckled hardwood floors, soaked drywall up to 1 foot high, ruined stored boxes/contents
case_facts.incident_discovered: Upon return from work trip; exact start date unknown

rationale: A major storm caused debris impact resulting in damage to the policyholder's garage roof, fence, and parked vehicle; the primary and most extensive damage is structural/property, though an auto component is also present and documented.

Cause is unknown debris, possibly a tree or neighbor's shed. Full property walk not yet completed. Auto damage component is documented and should be assessed concurrently. High severity — adjuster on-site response recommended urgently.

rationale: Wind caused direct structural damage (missing shingles) to the policyholder's own home, a classic property_damage scenario with no theft, liability, or auto elements.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee (POL-1006) reports wind damage from last weekend that blew approximately four shingles off the overhang above the back porch. No interior leaking or additional damage was noted. Estimated repair cost is ~$400; severity is low. Note: the policy deductible of $2,500 exceeds the estimated repair cost, so out-of-pocket payment is likely.
